newsitem.title: GERMANY: German DAX drops 1.8 pct in bourse trade.
newsitem.headline: German DAX drops 1.8 pct in bourse trade.

text.p: 1300 GMT - German shares decline sharply in bourse trade, with DAX ending down 1.8 percent at a two-week low. Dealers cite EMU, U.S. worries and the expiry of DAX options this week, often a cause of volatility.
* DAX ends down 59.80 points at 3,291.19 points.
* March DTB DAX futures down 30 at 3,301 points.
* Krupp confirms plans to launch takeover bid for Thyssen. Thyssen at 400 marks in unofficial trade.
* Chemical shares pressured, BASF most stable after slightly better than expected 1996 data.
